verdict.rationale: Ollama's own blog states it is compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, so tools like Claude Code can call the server with open models. The documented Claude Code integration (ollama launch, GitHub README) is consistent with that. Missing for 10: dedicated endpoint reference docs (path, supported fields, streaming/tool-use coverage or limitations), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models.
